title: One rulebook for every repo.
description: How the eng repo holds one set of engineering rules for every ideaSquared repo: rule IDs, MUST and SHOULD, checks, and a sweep that opens PRs to close gaps.
lede: Eight repos, one person, evenings only. We wrote the rules down once, made each one checkable, and let a weekly sweep find where a repo has drifted.
summary: 151 numbered rules in the eng repo, a repo-type table, and a sweep that opens a PR per repo. What the rules look like, and what the gap tables said on 24 November.
